accounts_kind_matches_subject.name: accounts_kind_matches_subject
accounts_kind_matches_subject.value: ("accounts"."kind" = 'Student' AND "accounts"."student_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("accounts"."kind" = 'Employee' AND "accounts"."employee_id" IS NOT NULL)

ledger_entries_balance_after_only_for_ac.name: ledger_entries_balance_after_only_for_account
ledger_entries_balance_after_only_for_ac.value: ("ledger_entries"."account_id" IS NOT NULL) = ("ledger_entries"."balance_after" IS NOT NULL)

notifications_audience_target.name: notifications_audience_target
notifications_audience_target.value:
("notifications"."audience" = 'Broadcast' AND "notifications"."account_id" IS NULL AND "notifications"."staff_user_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("notifications"."audience" = 'Account' AND "notifications"."account_id" IS NOT NULL AND "notifications"."staff_user_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("notifications"."audience" = 'Staff' AND "notifications"."staff_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "notifications"."account_id" IS NULL)
